      Schedule as plain text

      How that damage was worked out

      i

      Event severity (mild/typical/severe) isn't random — it's a fixed pattern per run number, so replaying the same run always faces the same challenge. Your first run is always "typical." From run 2 onward, the spread widens the more resilience skills you've unlocked overall — a stronger skill tree can hit lower lows and higher highs, not just an easier flat curve.

      Resources: 200

      Resilience: 0

      Growth: 0

      Mitigation

      i

      How much event damage you avoid. Each Resilience investment adds a flat 5%, capped at 85% total even if you max it out — Early Warning Systems adds another flat 10% on top once unlocked. It never reaches 100%; some damage always gets through.

      Play more runs to see how far you've come.

      Step
      i

      Growth doesn't protect you from event damage at all — each unit just adds 8 resources of passive income every time you face an event. It's a bet that the extra income outweighs skipping a point of damage mitigation.

      🎚️ Allocation presets

      A preset buys a set of units in one click, for example "Flood plan: 3 resilience, 1 growth". It stops at what you can afford and at the 85% resilience cap, and U undoes it as one click.

        Resilience knowledge: 0

        Purchase route

          i

          Knowledge earned per run is your leftover resources divided by 20, rounded — but never zero, even after a terrible run. Unlocked skills below are permanent: they carry into every future run, unlike Resilience/Growth investment, which resets to a fresh start each run. Some skills require others to be unlocked first.

          Reinforced Infrastructure — +2 starting resilience capacity

          Community Reserves — +50 starting resources

          Early Warning Systems — +10% mitigation on all events

          Adaptive Growth Practices — +1 starting growth capacity

          Mutual Aid Network — +5% mitigation on all events

          Civic Preparedness — -35% damage from social-shock events (Civil Unrest)

          Climate Hardening — -20% damage from weather events (Flood, Heatwave, Storm)

          🧱 Schedule builder

          Build your own event order (3 to 7 events), save it by name and run it. A run on it uses your skill tree, is tagged "custom schedule" in Past Runs and never goes on the hardest-schedule board; because you choose the events, its knowledge is scaled to the damage it throws compared with the Classic mix. The Code button gives a friend a code for the schedule alone.

            Saved schedules

              🤝 Run codes and challenges

              A run code carries a schedule and a result. Paste a friend's code to play the same events in the same order, struck by the same severity pattern, with your skill tree and memory switched off, so you both start from a fresh settlement. A challenge earns no knowledge and does not touch your history. Their result came from their own build, so it is a friendly note, never a ranking.
